failure_policy: Stop on the first failure and preserve every contact; no retry. This cell is TEXT-ONLY (construction-advantage-text) and spends one contact per disagreeing row, so a failed row is dropped from S3-5's curation input, counted, never silently retried.

The expected volume is about 213 contacts (0.3398 x 625), 0.3398 being the disagreement-pair rate the S3-3 dry run measured over 1,080 rows (docs/readiness/2026-09-22-slurp-stage3-rollout-r01-v1/s3-3-dry-run-receipt-v1.json); the engineering spec's own estimate is 300-500 rows out of the parent R01's 800. fit_endpoint_calls_cap 1,875 = 625 x (0 speech packets + 3 endpoints): this arm is TEXT ONLY (owner decision 82 and the D2 invariant, see the baseline fragment's modality_note), so planned_speech_audio_seconds and repeated_speech_audio_seconds_cap are 0 and no speech packet and no mmproj forward is ever opened. native_task_contract_calls_cap = 0: the one-phase advantage program carries no phase_tools. planned_gpu_hours 1.0 is the registered ceiling for the generation cell plus its fit pass (the engineering spec's own point estimate is about 0.3). Ceilings are bounds, never targets.
